# 2 Chronicles Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-said Solomon to-build a-house for-name-of YHWH and-a-house for-his-kingdom.

**2** And-he-counted Solomon seventy thousand men bearing-burdens and-eighty thousand men quarrying in-the-hill-country and-overseers over-them three-thousand and-six-hundreds.

**3** And-he-sent Solomon to-Huram king-of Tyre saying as-that you-dealt with-David my-father and-you-sent to-him cedars to-build for-him a-house to-dwell in-it.

**4** Behold I am-building a-house for-name-of YHWH my-God to-dedicate to-Him to-burn before-Him incense-of spices and-arrangement-of continual and-burnt-offerings for-the-morning and-for-the-evening for-the-sabbaths and-for-the-new-moons and-for-appointed-feasts-of YHWH our-God forever this upon Israel.

**5** And-the-house that I am-building is-great for greater is-our-God than-all the-gods.

**6** And-who retains strength to-build for-Him a-house for the-heavens and-heavens-of the-heavens not can-contain-Him and-who am-I that I-should-build for-Him a-house except to-burn-incense before-Him.

**7** And-now send to-me a-man wise to-work in-the-gold and-in-the-silver and-in-the-bronze and-in-the-iron and-in-the-purple and-the-crimson and-the-blue and-knowing to-engrave engravings with the-wise-men who are-with-me in-Judah and-in-Jerusalem whom prepared David my-father.

**8** And-send to-me trees-of cedar cypress and-algum from-the-Lebanon for I know that your-servants know to-cut trees-of the-Lebanon and-behold my-servants will-be with your-servants

**9** and-to-prepare for-me trees for-abundance for the-house that I am-building is-great and-wonderful.

**10** And-behold for-the-cutters for-the-hewers-of the-trees I-have-given wheat beaten-grain to-your-servants cors twenty-thousand and-barley cors twenty-thousand and-wine baths twenty-thousand and-oil baths twenty-thousand.

**11** And-he-said Huram king-of Tyre in-writing and-he-sent to Solomon because-loves YHWH His-people He-has-made-you king over-them.

**12** And-he-said Huram blessed-be YHWH God-of Israel who made the-heavens and-the-earth who gave to-David the-king a-son wise having-prudence and-understanding who-will-build a-house for-YHWH and-a-house for-his-kingdom.

**13** And-now I-have-sent a-man wise having-understanding Huram my-master-craftsman

**14** son-of a-woman from-daughters-of Dan and-his-father a-man-of Tyre knowing to-work in-the-gold and-in-the-silver in-the-bronze in-the-iron in-the-stones and-in-the-wood in-the-purple in-the-blue and-in-the-fine-linen and-in-the-crimson and-to-engrave every engraving and-to-devise every device that is-given to-him with your-wise-men and-wise-men-of my-lord David your-father.

**15** And-now the-wheat and-the-barley the-oil and-the-wine that said my-lord let-him-send to-his-servants.

**16** And-we we-will-cut trees from the-Lebanon according-to-all your-need and-we-will-bring-them to-you rafts upon sea-of Joppa and-you will-bring-them-up to-Jerusalem.

**17** And-he-counted Solomon all the-men the-sojourners who were-in land-of Israel after the-census that counted-them David his-father and-they-were-found a-hundred and-fifty thousand and-three thousand and-six-hundreds.

**18** And-he-made from-them seventy-thousand bearing-burdens and-eighty-thousand quarrying in-the-hill-country and-three-thousand and-six-hundreds overseers to-make-work the-people.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **2:5**: greater is-our-God than-all the-gods — Direct theological claim of YHWH's supremacy. Not monotheistic denial of other gods' existence but assertion of incomparable greatness.

- **2:6**: heavens and-heavens-of the-heavens — Superlative construction indicating the uttermost reaches of cosmic space. Even this cannot contain YHWH.

- **2:11**: because-loves YHWH His-people — Huram, a foreign king, acknowledges YHWH's covenant love for Israel as the basis of Solomon's kingship.


— EMET
